title: Create Solar Radiation Cooling Video
description: Build Cooling Part 3 (Solar Radiation & Glass) as beat-based Manim scenes with German on-screen text, English TTS narrations and compose scripts, following the generate-manim-tutorial skill and the dev's scene breakdown (I_S,max, A/F_F, F_V, g_tot, Q̇_S,tr).
summary: Built Cooling 4_solar_radiation as 5 beat scenes (I_S,max orientation chart, A·F_F, F_V Raffstore, g_tot = τ_e + q_i, master equation Q̇_S,tr) plus generate_audio/build_full_video/manim.cfg. Beat 3 was reworked on dev request from a face-on window to a vertical facade section carrying two situations — unshaded (full beam through the glass, F_V = 1,0) then the external Raffstore dropping in and reflecting the beam back outside (F_V = 0,15) — with derived slat/reflection geometry and a matching narration. All five beats smoke-rendered at -ql and frame-inspected; build_full_video.py ran end-to-end (-qh render → mux → compose, exit 0) producing a 75.5 s Full_Scene4_Solar_Radiation.mp4. Blocking-light occlusion is done via z_index with fully opaque frame/masonry/blind so blocked rays are genuinely cut. TTS returned 401 (invalid OpenAI key in NowIGetIt .env) — the five English narrations are staged in generate_audio.py and the final video currently carries no audio. Also repointed the stale scene_2 launch entry to merged_scenes.py Scene1 and ignored Manim partial_movie_files.
